commands.step: Verify tag matches every declared version
commands.text:
TAG="${RELEASE_TAG#v}"
PYPROJECT=$(python -c "import tomllib,pathlib;print(tomllib.loads(pathlib.Path('pyproject.toml').read_text())['project']['version'])")
PKGJSON=$(node -p "require('./package.json').version")
# Extracted with python, NOT a node one-liner: the obvious node version
# uses a regex replacement containing $1, and bash expands $1 inside
# double quotes to an empty positional parameter.
BINJS=$(python -c "import re,pathlib;print(re.search(r'version:\s*\"([^\"]+)\"', pathlib.Path('bin/comfy-preflight.js').read_text()).group(1))")
BINTAG=$(python -c "import re,pathlib;print(re.search(r'tag:\s*\"([^\"]+)\"', pathlib.Path('bin/comfy-preflight.js').read_text()).group(1))")
DUNDER=$(python -c "import re,pathlib;print(re.search(r'__version__ = \"([^\"]+)\"', pathlib.Path('src/comfy_preflight/__init__.py').read_text()).group(1))")
if [ "$BINTAG" != "$RELEASE_TAG" ]; then
  echo "::error::bin/comfy-preflight.js pins tag $BINTAG but this release is $RELEASE_TAG - npm-launcher would fetch the wrong release"
  exit 1
fi
echo "tag=$TAG pyproject=$PYPROJECT package.json=$PKGJSON bin=$BINJS __version__=$DUNDER"
fail=0
for pair in "pyproject:$PYPROJECT" "package.json:$PKGJSON" "bin/comfy-preflight.js:$BINJS" "__init__.py:$DUNDER"; do
  name="${pair%%:*}"; val="${pair#*:}"
  if [ "$val" != "$TAG" ]; then echo "::error::$name declares $val but the tag is $TAG"; fail=1; fi
done
[ "$fail" -eq 0 ]

python -m pip install --upgrade pip
python -m pip install -e ".[dev]" build
python verify.py

commands.step: Cut the GitHub Release with binaries + dists
commands.text:
NOTES=".github/release-notes-${RELEASE_TAG}.md"
# A partial release leaves the GitHub Release already created. Re-creating it would
# abort the job before the registry publishes that still need to run, so an existing
# release is uploaded into rather than treated as an error.
if gh release view "${RELEASE_TAG}" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "release ${RELEASE_TAG} already exists; uploading assets into it"
  gh release upload "${RELEASE_TAG}" assets/* dist/* --clobber
  exit 0
fi
if [ -f "$NOTES" ]; then
  gh release create "${RELEASE_TAG}" \
    --title "comfy-preflight ${RELEASE_TAG}" \
    --notes-file "$NOTES" --verify-tag assets/* dist/*
else
  gh release create "${RELEASE_TAG}" \
    --title "comfy-preflight ${RELEASE_TAG}" \
    --generate-notes --verify-tag assets/* dist/*
fi

commands.step: Install npm >=11.5 in a sandbox for OIDC
commands.text:
SANDBOX="$HOME/.npm-cli-sandbox"
mkdir -p "$SANDBOX"
pushd "$SANDBOX" >/dev/null
echo '{"name":"npm-cli-sandbox","version":"0.0.0","private":true}' > package.json
npm install --no-save --no-audit --no-fund --silent npm@latest
popd >/dev/null
echo "$SANDBOX/node_modules/.bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
"$SANDBOX/node_modules/.bin/npm" --version
